name: Job Search Assistant — live apply
postCreateCommand: pip install -r requirements.txt && pip install playwright && playwright install --with-deps chromium && chmod +x scripts/watch_apply.sh
postAttachCommand: bash -lc 'chmod +x scripts/*.sh 2>/dev/null; nohup ./scripts/queue_watcher.sh > /tmp/queue_watcher.log 2>&1 & echo; echo "👁  Queue watcher started — anything you queue in the app will be applied here, visibly."; echo "   Watch it: PORTS tab → port 6080 → open (no password)"; echo "   Log: tail -f /tmp/queue_watcher.log"; echo'
